cases.title: Agents entry opens a unique, understandable workspace

risk.rationale: A broken or duplicated entry path blocks a core workflow but is usually noticed immediately

preconditions: Tinto launches under Pumarejo and the Dashboard exposes Abrir Agents

action.description: Open Agents, return to Resumen, and open Agents again

cases.title: Keyboard traversal makes forward progress through Agents controls

risk.rationale: Keyboard users can be trapped even when pointer interaction appears healthy, and automated snapshots can miss the stall

preconditions: Agents is open and no external agent process is launched

action.description: Send sixteen bounded TAB actions and observe focus after every action

cases.title: Agents remains usable at the constrained 640 by 480 window

risk.rationale: Critical launch and management actions can become clipped at a realistic constrained desktop size

preconditions: Pumarejo can confirm native resize dimensions

action.description: Resize Agents to 640 by 480 and inspect the semantic tree and screenshot

cases.title: MCP management is discoverable without launching an agent

risk.rationale: The shipped MCP control plane has no usable value if its entry is absent or ambiguous in the native Agents workspace

preconditions: Agents is open on a registered project

action.description: Find and open the first enabled MCP, profile, or details control without launching a provider

cases.title: Provider availability and launch affordances do not contradict each other

risk.rationale: A launch control that appears usable for an unavailable provider leads directly into a failed core action

preconditions: Agents has completed its provider availability check

action.description: Compare visible availability status, provider selection, and launch enabled state without activating launch

cases.title: Agents home distinguishes open conversations from saved lifecycle history

risk.rationale: Contradictory active-state labels make users distrust whether an Agent is still operating

preconditions: Agents home has no open terminal and contains saved sessions

action.description: Compare the home summary with every saved-session lifecycle label

cases.title: A saved conversation opens with intact history and a clear resume affordance

risk.rationale: Conversation continuity is a core Agents workflow and a broken journal can strand prior work

preconditions: At least one saved transcript is visible

action.description: Open a saved transcript and inspect its prior content and continuation controls

cases.title: Transcript search can find, clear, and recover from no results

risk.rationale: Large Agent histories are impractical without reliable search and clear recovery

preconditions: A saved transcript with visible content is open

action.description: Search for known text, search for an absent sentinel, then clear the query

cases.title: Details and Agent Lens expose navigable files commands and timeline

risk.rationale: The evidence surface is essential for understanding and validating Agent work

action.description: Open Details and visit Files, Commands, and Timeline controls

cases.title: MCP inventory is attributable and safely read-only in saved transcripts

risk.rationale: Users must know which project and provider MCP state belongs to without mutating archived work

preconditions: Details is open for a saved transcript

action.description: Inspect MCP provider, target, project attribution, and disabled mutation controls

cases.title: A provider launch reaches a truthful terminal state or actionable failure

risk.rationale: Launching an Agent is the primary capability and silent or contradictory failure blocks all live work

preconditions: A registered disposable project/provider entry is selected
Recovery can close any newly created session

action.description: Launch one Agent and wait for ready, unavailable, or failed state

recovery.procedure: Close or stop only the campaign-created session and verify Tinto remains usable
recovery.verification: The created session is no longer active and the Agents home remains reachable

cases.title: A harmless turn can be sent and reaches a completed visible response

risk.rationale: A ready-looking Agent that cannot complete a turn is functionally broken

preconditions: Prompt forbids file and system mutation

action.description: Send a fixed no-tools echo prompt and observe progress through final response

recovery.procedure: Interrupt if still active at timeout, then close the campaign-created session
recovery.verification: No campaign response remains active and git state matches the pre-turn snapshot

cases.title: Active-turn interruption is explicit and leaves the conversation recoverable

risk.rationale: Users need a reliable escape hatch from long or mistaken Agent work

preconditions: Campaign-created Agent session can start a bounded long-running response

action.description: Start a bounded response, activate the explicit interrupt control, and verify the composer recovers

recovery.procedure: Close or stop the campaign-created session if interruption does not settle
recovery.verification: The session is idle or closed and the composer is not reporting an active turn

cases.title: Closing and reopening preserves one coherent conversation identity

risk.rationale: Duplicate or replaced identities during resume can lose context or replay work

preconditions: A campaign-created conversation exists and is no longer active

action.description: Close its panel, reopen it from recent sessions, and compare identity and transcript

recovery.procedure: Leave the created transcript closed and record its identifier for optional cleanup
recovery.verification: Exactly one saved transcript identity remains and no Agent process is active
